capabilities: Open .tex and .typ files in a split view
Render a live PDF preview while typing
Configure LaTeX and Typst compiler binary paths
Adjust line wrapping and preview debounce time
extras: Syntax highlighting and autocompletion come from codemirror-lang-latex and codemirror-lang-typst. Both compiler binary paths must be set in settings; the README's installation section is incomplete (code block only).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in editor for .tex and .typ files, so writing LaTeX or Typst means leaving the vault and recompiling manually.
summary: Split-view editor for LaTeX and Typst files with a live PDF-rendered preview inside Obsidian.
